summary: Completed comprehensive testing of India Travel Website MVP. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate). Frontend UI loads correctly with minor overlay interaction issues in search dropdown.

ui_bugs.issue: Search result items in dropdown have overlay interception preventing clicks
ui_bugs.workaround: Direct destination card clicks work fine, search shows results but clicking them is blocked by overlay

passed_tests: All 23 backend API endpoints working (100% success)
Homepage loads with hero section and search bar
Featured destinations grid displays correctly (13 cards found)
Destination cards clickable and navigate correctly
Destination detail pages load with all content
All 6 tabs work (Overview, Hotels, Attractions, Shopping, Transport, Map)
Hotels tab shows 3 hotel cards with prices and ratings
Attractions tab shows 4 attraction cards with entry fees
Shopping tab shows 3 shopping places with timings
Transport tab shows 4 transport options with price ranges
Interactive OpenStreetMap with Leaflet loads correctly
AI Travel Guide generates descriptions successfully
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix search dropdown overlay issue preventing clicks on search results. The search functionality works (results appear) but clicking individual results is blocked by overlay elements.
